evidence.title: Budget-Constrained Embodied Perception: Four Resource Walls and a Pre-Registered Evaluation of Access-Structured Perception on Open Models at less than 31B

summary: Researchers assess open-source AI models for embodied perception under strict budget constraints, identifying four key resource limitations. The pre-registered evaluation highlights challenges in access-structured perception for smaller-scale systems.
title: Study Evaluates Cost-Effective AI Perception Models Under 31B Parameters
